name: eventbrite_city_events
description: Find upcoming Eventbrite events in a city, optionally filtered by category and/or keyword. Reads Eventbrite's own public event-discovery pages (the same data a browser gets at eventbrite.com/d/<city>/...). Returns event name, time, venue, a ticket URL, and category tags. Does not include attendee/guest lists. A typo'd category silently falls back to all categories for that city — check `category_applied` in the response.

city.description: City, free text, e.g. "San Francisco", "San Francisco, CA", "London", "Austin, TX". Matched against Eventbrite's own place lookup.

category.description: Eventbrite category slug, e.g. "music", "food-and-drink", "business", "community", "health". Unrecognized slugs are ignored by Eventbrite (falls back to all categories) rather than erroring.

keyword.description: Free-text keyword to filter events, e.g. "jazz", "half marathon".

name: eventbrite_event
description: Get full detail for one Eventbrite event by its numeric event id: description, start/end time, venue, organizer, and ticket price range/availability. Does not include attendee/guest lists.

event_id.description: Numeric Eventbrite event id, e.g. "1996763292760". Found in event URLs (the trailing digits) or in eventbrite_city_events results (`id`).
